statements.text:
On Tuesday, the President revoked Biden-era vehicle pollution and fuel economy standards.

Why? He thinks too many EVs will strain the electric grid. 

Meanwhile, he wants to invest half-a-*trillion* dollars in AI, which will require far more energy than meeting EV goals. (1/2)

Mr. President, there’s people that are dying.

Millions of Americans are worried about losing their health care, affording groceries, and keeping a roof over their heads.

Our friends and neighbors are enduring abuses and inhumane treatment at the hands of ICE.

Innocent civilians, including children, are dying by the thousands in Gaza.

Ukrainians are defending their country and sovereignty against Russia.

Our servicemembers, including those suffering aboard the USS Lincoln, are being put in harm’s way to fight an illegal war in the Middle East that nobody asked for.

And this is what the President is spending his time on? Childish AI slop bullying our closest neighbor and ally.

Get a grip.
